methodology.title: The Gauntlet Pod & Store Credit Prizing System
methodology.summary: An 8-week (2-month) season with 5 scheduled games in skill-matched pods of 8–10 players, featuring +1000/+500 BP bonus scoring, flexible In-Pod & Out-of-Pod Ringer rules, and Store Credit prizing for Top 2 in every pod.

scoring_breakdown.win: Actual Game VP + 1,000 Bonus Battle Points (including 10 pts Paint Score; max 1,100 BP)
scoring_breakdown.draw: Actual Game VP + 500 Bonus Battle Points
scoring_breakdown.loss: Actual Game VP + 0 Bonus Battle Points (0–100 VP)
scoring_breakdown.in_pod_ringer_win: Actual Game VP + 1,000 Bonus Battle Points (last 2 weeks vs unassigned same-pod opponent)
scoring_breakdown.out_of_pod_ringer_win: Actual Game VP + 500 Bonus Battle Points (last 2 weeks vs different-pod opponent)

faction_rules.lock_policy: Faction locked for the entire 2-month season. May only switch factions mid-season if games played = 0 and TOs are notified.
faction_rules.list_policy: Flexible lists, detachments, and sub-factions between games. Proxies permitted on correct base sizes with opponent clarity.

promotion_relegation_rules.promotion: Top 2 finishers in Pods 2–3 earn Brute Force Games store credit prizing and promotion into higher pods next season
promotion_relegation_rules.relegation: Pod standings determine next season's pod placement across Avatars of War (Pod 1), Battle Hardened (Pod 2), and Blooded (Pod 3)
promotion_relegation_rules.finals_qualification: Top 2 finishers in Pod 1 (Avatars of War) claim the Seasonal Championship & Premier Store Credit Prizing

disciplinary_cards.yellow_card: Fewer than 3 games completed in a season results in a Yellow Card warning.
disciplinary_cards.red_card: Second consecutive season with <3 games results in a Red Card (must sit out 1 season).
disciplinary_cards.black_card: 3 Red Cards or severe conduct violation results in removal from the league.

methodology.chess_clock_policy: Optional by mutual agreement when scheduling the match. Recommended 1.5 to 2 hours per player.
tiebreakers: 1. Total Battle Points (Win +1000 / Draw +500 / Out-of-Pod Ringer Win +500 + Game VP)
